retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s jazz album layout featuring a high-contrast, warm-toned portrait offset by left-aligned, multi-colored sans-serif typography and a repeating top border.

recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, warm-toned portrait of a woman in a pink garment positioned on the right, balanced by a block of left-aligned, stacked sans-serif text in cyan, magenta, and black on a textured gold-beige background, topped with a repeating 'STEREO' banner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-heavy with gaze directed downward and inward
Text block anchored to the upper-left quadrant
Repeating horizontal banner at the extreme top edge
High-contrast color palette of cyan, magenta, and gold
coreInvariants: Grainy, film-like texture across the entire composition
Left-aligned text block with varying font weights and colors
Repeating 'STEREO' text banner at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close portrait of a woman occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark hair and the vibrant magenta of her clothing provide the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text block, moves down through the tracklist, then follows the subject's downward gaze toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left-center area acts as a textured gold-beige breathing room between the text and the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm gold-beige background with a grainy texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep magenta and vibrant cyan for primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for secondary tracklist text and deep shadows in the portrait.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the magenta clothing and cyan text against a muted, mid-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky capitals for primary titles
Condensed, tall capitals for secondary titles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting colors (cyan vs magenta) and widths (wide vs condensed) within the same sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Repeating text banner at the top edge
Small abstract logo centered below the text block

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and grotesque feel of the primary title.
Approximates the condensed, heavy feel of the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, warm-toned portrait of a woman in a magenta dress on a gold-beige background, leaving the top-left quadrant clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a repeating 'STEREO' banner in magenta at the top. Place the main title in cyan heavy sans-serif, the artist name in magenta condensed sans-serif, and the tracklist in black bold sans-serif, all left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the 'STEREO' banner present at the top?
Are the colors cyan, magenta, and black used for text?
Is the overall texture grainy and film-like?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of the gold-beige background
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles
postGenerationChecks: Check for repeating 'STEREO' text at the top edge
Ensure the subject is positioned on the right with a downward gaze
Confirm the background has a visible paper/film texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy, warm-toned portrait on the right with a structured, multi-colored sans-serif text block on the left, topped by a repeating utility banner.
